title: Software Engineering Is Becoming Plan and Review — Louis Knight-Webb, Vibe Kanban
talk_summary: The speaker argues AI coding shifts engineering toward planning and review, with plan-heavy specs for backend/migrations and tighter in-loop review for frontend. He demos Vibe Kanban's parallel worktrees and PR shepherding, then shuts the company down because reselling tokens to individuals was not sustainable.

takeaways.what_they_do: Spend upfront planning/spec interrogation for backend, migrations, and refactors; use in-loop review for frontend feature work where state and edge cases are hard to spec.
takeaways.evidence_quote: spending 5 minutes of planning saves you 30 minutes of reviewing AI-generated code

takeaways.technique: Parallel in-flight work to hide long runs
takeaways.what_they_do: Run multiple coding-agent workspaces concurrently so when one finishes, another is ready for review; avoids waiting on long agent runs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the way you get around the waiting problem is you have multiple of them on the go at any given time

takeaways.technique: Batch review handoffs, avoid context thrash
takeaways.what_they_do: Design agent handoff to run long then yield a complete review packet with diff, preview, and comments rather than interrupting the human every 30 seconds.
takeaways.evidence_quote: an agent can run for as long as possible and then yield back to the human rather than encouraging patterns where you're constantly jumping in and out

takeaways.what_they_do: Have the agent run the app and click through with Playwright/browser automation to find UI bugs before human review.
takeaways.evidence_quote: AI starts to be able to QA front-end work... run your project, click around, and find the bugs

takeaways.what_they_do: Monitor GitHub PRs for comments and CI, then react automatically to shepherd a change from done to deployed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: monitor GitHub pull requests and just look for comments and kind of be reactionary to those automatically

takeaways.technique: Per-task git worktree plus setup script
takeaways.what_they_do: Each agent workspace creates a git worktree and runs a setup script to install dependencies before the agent runs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: It's running a setup script. What it's created a Git work tree. It has run a setup script in the work tree to install the dependencies
